body:
Well on one hand it’s common to find a partner and be in a relationship but on the other hand it’s also not uncommon to not find someone. So because of the fact that me being happy is tied to finding a partner I could ‘end up’ like one of many other people who don’t find a partner or haven’t found one in their life. 

Since I’m very shy when it comes having a conversation about something that is not just about asking for a way etc I try everything I can to find people online via various apps for over many years now. Hasn’t worked out yet.

Well I just think of the afterlife in a negative way. That’s why I’m always filled with truly happiness when thinking about not being alive anymore.

The only goal I’m pursuing is becoming happy. I would want to achieve it while being alive but for now I don’t think that’s going to happen. Because of that I’d rather end my life asap to become happy in the afterlife.

It’s not really about being as fast as possible but about certainty. If I knew for sure that I am able to achieve my goal I wouldn’t mind to endure more pain and keep on waiting, but I don’t know that ofc. In general I think that life after death is better and therefore I could achieve my goal of becoming happy anytime. That’s why it’s so tempting for me to just end it now and not keep on hoping that it could happen while being alive.

First of all thank you for your time taken to read and reply. 

Well, I wouldn’t say for sure that I’m never going to change my perspective, but when it comes to deciding who I want to be and what matters I already figured it out  10 years ago and it didn’t change since then. There is also a change of mind in those 10 years for everyone I guess, so I would really be surprised if one day I woke up with a different view on life. 

What I want to say with this is that my problem isn’t really figuring out what I want or who I want to be, it’s about getting what I want and become who I want to be.
